properties.name: Terra Sundaica
properties.principle: Southeast Asia to its continental margin: Myanmar with the Indo-Burman ranges, Indochina, the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Java, Borneo, the Philippines, the South China Sea and all of Wallacea, from the Red River fault (ZR22) to Lydekker's Line at the Sahul shelf's edge (ZR23).
